target.title: [codex] Clear stale ChatGPT conversation cookies
target.body:
## Summary
- Clear stale ChatGPT temporary-conversation cookies (`conv*`) after browser cookie sync and before navigation/submission.
- Apply the cleanup to both local/manual-login browser runs and remote Chrome runs.
- Keep auth/session cookies and non-ChatGPT cookies untouched.

## Why
ChatGPT temporary chats can accumulate `conv_key_*` cookies over repeated browser automation runs. Those stale conversation cookies are sent back to ChatGPT and can bloat request headers enough to trigger header-size failures such as “header too long.”

This cleanup is intentionally narrow: it only deletes case-sensitive `conv*` cookies on `chatgpt.com` / `chat.openai.com`, and it never logs cookie values.

I also noticed current `main` already includes a separate browser fix for truncated Pro answers during the thinking-to-answer transition, so this PR focuses only on stale temporary-conversation cookies.

## Validation
- `pnpm exec vitest run tests/browser/cookies.test.ts`
- `pnpm run format:check`
- `pnpm run lint`
- `pnpm run build`
